_help: daily_cap: submissions per day (counted from the applied log); top_n: jobs per run; min_match: extra floor on the score; submit: false = never submit (the default for a new workspace: review the first applications, then turn it on) (needs ANSWERS_POOL settings.auto_submit too); headless: unattended fills without a window; cv_by_family: {role family: CV pdf}; default_cv: CV used when no other fits (null = each job needs its own CV)
